items.author: ragingdeicide.bsky.social
items.context: does anyone have any suggestions for cozy games to stream?
items.text: Stardew Valley, Unpacking and Powerwash Simulator are all calm and easy to talk over while chat watches.

items.author: ambyrvi.bsky.social
items.context: Question for other Stardew Valley players: Do you have a specific NPC that you target for friendship first during each run and what do you think your choice says about you as a person?
items.text: Fun question! Whoever you pick, birthday gifts of a loved item are a fast way to build friendship.
